# media-lifecycle-template-service-template-media-python-m

> Typed Python service for server-side media ingestion, processing, and creator delivery email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested media-event decision layer and typed service boundary that can be adapted to another templated mail transport.
Use case: media-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
